title: In a library, a compile uses one person's grid, never a blend
description:
## Behavior
In a library several people may correct the same sample. The grid a compile uses is one person's, never a blend.

```gherkin
Feature: One person's grid

  Scenario: Your grid is yours
    Given a library where I and another person each have warp markers on "steady-120.wav"
    When I compile a score from the library
    Then the clip uses my warp markers only

  Scenario: Without yours, the analysis grid
    Given a library where only another person has warp markers on "steady-120.wav"
    When I compile a score from the library
    Then the clip uses the analysis grid

  Scenario: Locally you are the library's owner
    Given a local library whose warp markers were imported by its owner
    When I run "apricity render steady.apr --library L -o out.wav"
    Then the render uses those warp markers
```
Open question for the owner: should a curator's grid be the fallback for everyone (a corrected catalog), instead of the analysis's?
